title: Neighborhood Scout
description: Travel safely from Home Base through Newton Centre all the way to the Newton Free Library.

steps.instruction: Head up to Newton Centre and grab a scoop at J.P. Licks (46 Langley Rd).
Continue northwest to find Librarian Clara at the Newton Free Library (330 Homer St).

title: The Mystery of the Wooden Chest
description: Solve the riddle to find the hidden Little Free Library near Oakdale Woods.

steps.instruction: Riddle: 'I have pages but no web, I stand near tall green oaks near Oakdale Woods.'

title: The Rosenfeld's Grand Delivery
description: Pick up warm challah & bagels from Rosenfeld's Bagels in Newton Centre and deliver them to Ranger Rick at Oakdale Woods.

steps.instruction: Obtain Fresh Challah & Bagels from Rosenfeld's Bagels (1280 Centre St).
Deliver the warm bakery bag safely south past Weeks Field to Oakdale Woods.
